concepts.statement_en: Given approved equipment, a fictional client, and a current measurement protocol, take, record, and communicate a BP reading within scope.
Given a watch and training partner, measure, record, and report pulse using the approved protocol.
Given a training partner and thermometer, measure and record both accurately.
Given age-appropriate tools, perform and document measurement with dignity and assistance where needed.
Given fictional child measurements and an approved chart, plot correctly and identify whether qualified review is needed.
Given approved tape and a training model, measure and record MUAC and identify the reviewed referral action.
Given fictional height/weight/age, calculate or plot using the correct approved tool and state a safe follow-up.
